# Storefront Studio

> Fixed-price websites for US local businesses (barbers, salons, restaurants, dentists, contractors and more), live the same day. Free homepage concept before payment. Starter $1,200 (founding $960), Standard $2,000 (founding $1,600), care plan $79/month. 50% deposit, refundable if the first design isn't liked.

Contact: +1 (614) 967-9783 (AI assistant, 24/7), huszageorge25@gmail.com

## Guides
- [How Much Does a Small Business Website Cost in 2026?](https://huszageorge25-wq.github.io/guides/small-business-website-cost/): Honest price ranges for small business websites in the US: website builders, freelancers, agencies and fixed-price studios, plus what you should get for the money.
- [Google Business Profile Checklist for Local Businesses](https://huszageorge25-wq.github.io/guides/google-business-profile-checklist/): A plain-English checklist to get more calls from Google Maps: categories, hours, photos, reviews, and how your website supports your profile.
- [The 12-Point Website Checklist for Local Businesses](https://huszageorge25-wq.github.io/guides/local-business-website-checklist/): Check your current website in five minutes. Twelve things every local business website needs so people on their phones call, book or visit.
- [Do I Need a Website If I Already Have a Facebook Page?](https://huszageorge25-wq.github.io/guides/do-i-need-a-website-if-i-have-facebook/): Facebook and Instagram are great, but they don't replace a website. Here's what a website does that social media can't, in plain words for local business owners.
- [Why Doesn't My Business Show Up on Google Maps?](https://huszageorge25-wq.github.io/guides/why-my-business-doesnt-show-on-google-maps/): The most common reasons a local business is missing from Google Maps or ranks low, and what to fix first. A plain-English checklist.
- [How to Get More Google Reviews (the Honest Way)](https://huszageorge25-wq.github.io/guides/how-to-get-more-google-reviews/): Simple, allowed ways for local businesses to get more Google reviews: when to ask, what to say, a short link, and how to reply.
- [Website vs Google Business Profile: Do You Need Both?](https://huszageorge25-wq.github.io/guides/website-vs-google-business-profile/): What a Google Business Profile does, what a website does, and why local businesses get the most calls when the two work together.
- [How Much Does a Barbershop Website Cost?](https://huszageorge25-wq.github.io/guides/barbershop-website-cost/): Realistic costs for a barbershop website in the US: DIY builders, booking-app pages, freelancers and fixed-price studios, and what a good barber site needs.
